hw_name.description: Extra functions added by the RFP build.

basic_duty_enable.description: Duty control: when the requested duty drops below the present duty, the motor is released: no braking and no acceleration (zero current, the bridge stays on) until the duty falls to the request, then it follows it again. Off: the Duty Downramp regulator brakes to follow a falling request.

hybrid_enable.description: Forward requests: the duty is limited proportionally to the throttle, so half throttle gives half torque and, without load, about half speed. Duty limit = throttle x Duty Limit at Full Throttle x Maximum Duty Cycle. The current decreases linearly over the Soft Zone Before Duty Limit and is zero at the limit. Applies to relative current requests: ADC and PPM apps, VESC Remote, PAS, CAN. The VESC Tool keyboard (absolute current) is not affected.

hybrid_duty_limit.description: Duty limit (about the speed) at full throttle, as a fraction of Maximum Duty Cycle.

hybrid_band.description: Zone below the duty limit, as a part of it, where the current decreases progressively to zero. Wider = softer arrival at the speed.

braking_reverse_enable.description: On: the Braking and Reverse settings apply to reverse requests (negative relative current). Off: official behaviour (negative current, then reverse at full current). Applies to relative current requests: ADC and PPM apps, VESC Remote, PAS, CAN. The VESC Tool keyboard (absolute current) is not affected.

stop_erpm.description: Below this speed the vehicle is considered stopped: end of braking, start of the reverse handling. Sensorless motors: keep a few hundred ERPM (speed reading is noisy near standstill).

stop_hyst.description: Once reversing (below Stop ERPM), braking resumes only above Stop ERPM + this margin (in % of Stop ERPM). Avoids switching back and forth around Stop ERPM.

rev_transition.description: Time over which the current fades from the braking value to the reverse value (and back), instead of a sudden change. 0 = immediate.

braking_mode.description: Reverse request while rolling forward faster than Stop ERPM. Active: negative current as in the official firmware: torque against the motion, current injected from the battery when regeneration is not enough, down to Stop ERPM. Regen Only: brake current (as the No Reverse control types): regeneration only, phases shorted when the current cannot be held.

brake_taper_start_erpm.description: Active braking: below this speed the braking becomes softer, down to Braking Force at Stop at Stop ERPM. Limits the overshoot into reverse.

brake_taper_min.description: Active braking: braking force left at Stop ERPM, as a part of the request. 100 % = no softening (official).

reverse_mode.description: Reverse request below Stop ERPM (stopped or already reversing). Current: reverse in current up to Reverse Current Max, top reverse speed limited by Reverse Max Duty (100 % = official firmware). None: never reverse, zero current. Duty: reverse duty = request x Reverse Max Duty; Basic Duty Mode applies when the request is released. Current, Duty Limited: reverse at Reverse Current Max (no ramp, immediate torque), speed capped by a duty limit = request x Reverse Max Duty; the current decreases over the Soft Zone below the limit and is zero above it (released, never braking). Reverse Ramp Time ramps the current (Current), the duty (Duty) or the duty limit (Current, Duty Limited).

rev_cur_max.description: Current: reverse current at full request. Current, Duty Limited: reverse current. Fraction of the motor current limit.

rev_duty_max.description: Fraction of Maximum Duty Cycle. Current: top reverse speed (100 % = no limit). Duty: duty at full reverse request. Current, Duty Limited: duty limit at full reverse request.

rev_band.description: Current and Current, Duty Limited: zone below the duty limit, as a part of Reverse Max Duty, where the current decreases progressively to zero.

rev_ramp.description: Time for the reverse current (Current), duty (Duty) or duty limit (Current, Duty Limited) to rise from 0 to its full value. It falls at once when the request is reduced. 0 = no ramp (official).

rev_repress.description: Current, Duty, Current Duty Limited: braking never turns into reverse. To reverse: stopped, release to neutral, press the brake once (above Reverse Arm Level) and release: reverse is armed, the next press reverses. Neutral longer than Reverse Disarm Time, or any throttle, disarms.

rev_arm_level.description: Re-press to Reverse: brake level of the press that arms the reverse.

rev_disarm_time.description: Re-press to Reverse: time in neutral after which the armed reverse is disarmed.

tractor_enable.description: On: the throttle (relative current request) drives the tractor spring below instead of the motor current. Off: normal operation. Applies to relative current requests: ADC and PPM apps, VESC Remote, PAS, CAN. The VESC Tool keyboard (absolute current) is not affected.

tractor_mode.description: Virtual spring on the wheel position (tachometer). An anchor position is held with zero throttle and moves with the throttle. Within Free Play of the anchor the motor is free; beyond, a force proportional to the distance pulls the wheel back (Stiffness). Damping opposes the free motion. For stairs, mud... Spring Current: output in current. Spring Duty: output in duty (to try). Any other command (brake, duty, keyboard, timeout) stops the tractor at once.

tractor_speed_mode.description: Throttle: anchor speed proportional to the throttle, up to Tractor Max ERPM. Preset: the anchor moves at Tractor Max ERPM as soon as the throttle is pressed (direction given by its sign).

tractor_max_erpm.description: Anchor speed at full throttle (or the preset speed).

tractor_freedom.description: Free play around the anchor, in electrical degrees (the tachometer counts 60 degree steps).

tractor_stiffness.description: Spring Current: current per electrical degree beyond Free Play.

tractor_brake.description: Spring Current: current against the speed difference to the anchor, per 1000 ERPM.

tractor_max_current.description: Spring Current: current limit (also capped by the motor limit).

tractor_max_lag.description: Largest distance between the wheel and the anchor, in electrical degrees. When the wheel is blocked the anchor stops moving away beyond it (no huge pull when it frees).

tractor_duty_stiffness.description: Spring Duty: duty per electrical degree beyond Free Play.

tractor_duty_brake.description: Spring Duty: duty against the speed difference to the anchor, per 1000 ERPM.

tractor_max_duty.description: Spring Duty: duty limit, as a fraction of Maximum Duty Cycle.

adc_ctrl_type.description: Replaces the Control Type of the ADC app (App to Use = ADC); all the other ADC app settings (voltages, filter, deadband, throttle curves, ramps, safe start, cruise button, multiple ESCs, traction control) still apply. App ADC Setting: the Control Type of the ADC app is used. Current Reverse ADC2: ADC1 = forward, ADC2 = reverse, sent as a signed relative current (-100 % to +100 %), so the Braking / Reverse settings handle ADC2 (see ADC2 Brake Priority). ADC1 uses the linear mapping (Start / End voltages, no center).

adc_brake_priority.description: Current Reverse ADC2: On: when ADC2 is pressed (above the ADC app deadband) ADC1 is ignored. Off: request = ADC1 - ADC2.
